<USER_REQUEST>
You are a Quality & Engineering Auditor reviewing Callisto's Graph Engine & Solver:
- crates/callisto-graph/ (all files in src/ including aggregate.rs, apply.rs, cascade.rs, commands/, infer.rs, plan.rs, tags.rs, toposort.rs, walk.rs, crosscheck.rs, resolver.rs)

Perform a line-by-line code audit to identify defects #821 through #890:
1. Worklist solver termination and fixpoint convergence edge cases in cascade propagation.
2. Group version alignment logic in Linked vs Fixed groups (Spec §G.6.7 compliance).
3. Pre-release mode state transitions (pre.json, exit mode, prerelease bump severities).
4. Command options forwarding omissions (status, version, plan_publish, tag, pr_body, validate, snapshot, init).
5. Cyclic dependency resolution, empty workspace handling, and monorepo package name collision edge cases.

Inspect files directly using view_file and grep_search. Return a technical report listing confirmed defects with file:line references, root cause analysis, failing scenario, and recommended fix/test.
</USER_REQUEST>
